body:
> We need a better name than indexSelector because what we are really providing is a sort results widget.
> What about `sortOrderSelector` for this widget name?

I've been thinking about it and:

* the sorting is really not a UI thing with Algolia: it appears very confusing to me to have a "sort" widget because what this widget will do is update the targeted index and will not deal at all with sorts
* I'm not sure we need to make it display the "Sort by:" label

At the end it's really an `indexSelector` and the user is free to use it to configure the sort orders if he built the slaves to do it.
